title: Lesson 8: Single/Multi-Level Cards, Layouts & Repeaters
description: Construct single and multi-level FlexCards, organizing data using layouts, and repeaters.

questions.question: How do you render a list of related Cases inside an Account FlexCard?
options: Add a repeater bound to the Cases array
questions.explanation: Repeaters iterate arrays in the data JSON to render nested lists.

questions.question: What distinguishes a multi-level FlexCard from a single-level one?
options: Multi-level supports nested/repeated data structures; single-level renders one flat record set
questions.explanation: Multi-level handles nested data via repeaters; single-level is a flat record list.

questions.question: Which layout mechanism positions FlexCard elements?
questions.explanation: The editor lays elements out on a 12-column grid with adjustable widths.
